note: Computed by mobile/scripts/build-arm-rig.mjs from body-lite.json/.bin. The pack is not changed. Pivots and axes are computed from the mesh. Segment rules are explicit name rules with a reason each.

forward.evidence: the eyes are in front of the back of the skull, and the foot bones reach further than the heel

patientRight.evidence: the right humerus is on the negative x side

axes.note: Right-handed system: +x is the patient's left, +y is up, +z is forward. Units are metres.

signConventions.elevation: angle of the upper arm from hanging (0), positive = up. Negative = backward (extension), see ANIMATION.md.
signConventions.plane: direction of elevation: 0 = side (frontal plane), 90 = forward (sagittal plane), 30 = scapular plane. Elevation direction u = (-x)*cos(plane) + z*sin(plane); negative elevation moves the arm towards -z (backward).
signConventions.rotation: humeral rotation about the long axis, positive = external (outward). With the arm hanging and the elbow bent 90 degrees, positive rotation swings the hand from forward (+z) to outward (-x).
signConventions.elbow: elbow flexion, 0 = straight; positive bends the forearm forward (+z) when the arm hangs.
signConventions.scapula: girdle rotation about the sternoclavicular joint, axis perpendicular to the scapular plane, positive = upward rotation (the glenoid rises).
